title: Act: Add effects schema, effect entities and fade transition
summary: Implement effect definitions, creation and transitions.
description: Extend sceneSchema, create effect entities, add runTransition and wire into buildScene and WorldScene; add effect entries to bedroom.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: Scenes without effects parse with an empty effects list and effect entries create dust and overlay handles
runTransition calls fade out, then swap, then fade in

steps.action: Add effectSchema = z.object({id: z.string(), type: z.enum(['dust','ambientLight']), asset: z.string().optional(), count: z.number().int().positive().optional(), color: z.number().optional(), alpha: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional()}) and add effects: z.array(effectSchema).default([]) to sceneSchema; export type EffectSpec.
steps.expected: Scenes without effects parse with effects []

steps.action: Add optional field effects?: { id: string; type: 'dust'|'ambientLight'; asset?: string; count?: number; color?: number; alpha?: number }[] to SceneDef.

Export createEffects(ctx: RenderContext, defs: SceneDef['effects'], resolveTexture): DisplayHandle[]; for type dust call ctx.addParticles(resolveTexture(def.asset), def.count ?? 20) and setDepth(layerDepth('effects')); for ambientLight call ctx.addOverlay(def.color ?? 0xffb347, def.alpha ?? 0.15) and setDepth(layerDepth('effects')).
Export runTransition(ctx: RenderContext, swap: () => void, durationMs = 400): void calling ctx.fade('out', durationMs, () => { swap(); ctx.fade('in', durationMs, () => {}); }).
steps.expected: Order fade out, swap, fade in

steps.action: After creating entities, call createEffects(ctx, scene.effects ?? [], resolveTexture) and include the handles in BuiltScene.destroy().

Add top-level effects list with {id: dust, type: dust, asset: effects/dust, count: 24} and {id: warm-light, type: ambientLight, color: 16758855, alpha: 0.12}; confirm the dust manifest id by reading manifest.json before writing.
Subscribe reactToPhaser 'transitionTo' and call runTransition(ctx, () => rebuild scene for the sceneId) ; unsubscribe on SHUTDOWN.
